card.name: Unique Houses Village

site.text: An ordinary village on level ground; the player gave no site, so a plain village layout is used.

style.text: Mixed, hand-built look where every house has its own shape, roof, and materials.

purpose.text: A home base village for living in, where each home is individual.

card.interpretation: You only asked that no two houses be alike. I took that as a rule for the whole village: every house gets its own shape, roof, and materials. Site, style, and purpose were left open, so I picked a medium village on level ground with a mixed hand-built look and a home-base purpose. Difficulty is patron, as in your settings.
assumptions: No set style; varied materials per house
Search for a suitable spot, since no location was given

program.notes: No two alike: each differs in footprint shape, roof form, wall materials, and details such as porches, chimneys, or upper floors.
Each distinct from every other house in massing, roof pitch, and palette.
Gathering place at the heart of the village, with its own character.
Small working smithy that serves the homes.
